# Seal lying on the ice, head up and forward (-Y). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Seal --base-color 0.118 0.376 0.431 --no-slot
material new Muzzle --base-color 0.353 0.725 0.659 --no-slot
material new Nose --base-color 0.176 0.106 0.000 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --name Body --segments 8 --rings 5 --radius 0.5 --location 0 0.08 0.17
scale 0.46 1.0 0.34
apply --scale
material assign Seal
add mesh uv-sphere --name Head --segments 8 --rings 5 --radius 0.5 --location 0 -0.42 0.38
scale 0.3 0.32 0.28
apply --scale
material assign Seal
add mesh uv-sphere --name Snout --segments 6 --rings 3 --radius 0.5 --location 0 -0.58 0.34
scale 0.17 0.14 0.12
apply --scale
material assign Muzzle
add mesh cube --name Nosetip --size 1 --location 0 -0.66 0.37
scale 0.08 0.05 0.06
apply --scale
material assign Nose
add mesh cone --name Tail --vertices 4 --radius1 0.16 --radius2 0 --depth 0.3 --location 0 0.66 0.1 --rotation -90 0 45
apply --rotation
scale 1.6 1 0.5
apply --scale
material assign Seal
add mesh cube --name FlipL --size 1 --location -0.25 -0.15 0.05
scale 0.16 0.24 0.06
apply --scale
material assign Seal
add mesh cube --name FlipR --size 1 --location 0.25 -0.15 0.05
scale 0.16 0.24 0.06
apply --scale
material assign Seal
select all
active Body
join
rename Body Seal
shade flat
export seal.glb
